[Act: companies
 Chapter: National Company Law Tribunal and Appellate Tribunal
 Section: 433::Limitation.
]


The provisions of the Limitation Act, 1963 (36 of 1963) shall, as far as may be, apply to proceedings or appeals before the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal, as the case maybe.
